/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A5) -/

/-- Owner of the local of index `i` of `ls` (parent, owning local, kind) in the new frame `f`:
the owning local if any, the new frame otherwise (A5). -/
def localOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (f i : Nat) : Holder :=
  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
  | some o => .place o
  | none => .frame f

/-- Places after `enterFrame`: the locals `ls` appended, owned by the new frame `nF` or by an
earlier local (A5). -/
def enterP (s : S3) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Place :=
  s.P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), localOwner ls s.nF i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩

/-- Indices, relative to `ls`, of the root locals (no parent). -/
def rootIdx (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Nat :=
  (List.range ls.length).filter fun i => ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)).isNone

/-- Effect of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6) with parameters `ps` and locals `ls`: new frame
`nF` pushed; the parameters, derived by the caller, are now held by the new frame (A3); locals
appended, uninitialised, without dependency, alive and unpinned; one active root `Modify`
authority per root local on its footprint, held by the owner of the local (pass-1
arbitrage 2; A4). -/
def enterEff (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : S3 :=
  { F := s.nF :: s.F, nF := s.nF + 1, P := enterP s ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
    A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A ++
      (rootIdx ls).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i), localOwner ls s.nF i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
    freed := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.freed q
    pin := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.pin q }

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6): the calling frame is active (non-empty
stack); each parameter is an active authority derived by the caller and held by it (A3); the
parent and the owner of a local are earlier locals; a part has the owner of its
parent. -/
def EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  s.F ≠ [] ∧
  (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
    y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => s.P.length ≤ r ∧ r < s.P.length + i ∧
      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - s.P.length]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => s.P.length ≤ o ∧ o < s.P.length + i) True

instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) := by
  unfold EnterPre; infer_instance

/-- `enterFrame` as a relation (MM-03.3 §4, O6; A3). -/
def EnterStep (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (s : S3) :
    Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls)

## 10. Théorèmes du premier jalon

Le premier jalon doit viser :

- `derive_preserves_exclusivity`
- `split_preserves_exclusivity`
- `effective_exclusive`
- `release_restores_authority`
- `transfer_no_duplicate_authority`
- `transfer_invalidates_source`
- `depend_preserves_anchor_validity`
- `dependent_cannot_escape_frame`
- `exitFrame_releases_all`
- `arena_issue_preserves_disjointness`
- `arena_issue_keeps_earlier_blocks`
- `arena_reset_rejects_live_dependents`
- `reachable_access_invariant`

Les noms sont indicatifs.

Une preuve qui réénonce directement une précondition comme conclusion ne constitue pas, à elle seule, une validation suffisante du mécanisme.

Les théorèmes doivent notamment établir la préservation des invariants par les transitions successives et les propriétés non triviales des autorités effectives.

## 11. Cas d'épreuve

### O7 — `exitFrame`

**Préconditions**

1. Tous les transferts de résultats sont valides.
2. Aucune autorité détenue par le cadre sortant ne reste active illégalement.
3. Aucune valeur encore utilisable dans un cadre survivant ne dépend d'une ancre propre au cadre sortant.
4. Les autorités retournées ont été transférées et rattachées légalement.
5. Les obligations applicables de nettoyage et de ressources sont respectées.

**Effets**

- Fin de validité des emplacements locaux non transférés.
- Restitution des autorités locales restantes.
- Suppression des correspondances de paramètres propres au cadre.
- Retour au cadre appelant.

Les emplacements locaux ne deviennent pas persistants simplement parce qu'un pointeur vers leur stockage a été copié.

Une autorité issue d'une ancre de l'appelant peut survivre au retour uniquement si son transfert et son rattachement sont valides.

Cette règle représente la sortie d'un cadre. Elle ne fixe pas encore les mécanismes syntaxiques de nettoyage différé.

findings.title: Report (i) says the 38 renamed statements have identical content, but 23 of them also use WF3, whose meaning changed
findings.location: formal/reports/MM03_v0.1_p3.md, section (i), paragraph "Inv3 renommé Inv3base (38)" and the bullet "Ceux qui concluent WF3 … concluent davantage"
findings.claim: The renaming paragraph says: "Le texte ne diffère que par ce nom ; Inv3base est mot pour mot l'Inv3 de la passe 2. Le contenu est donc identique". That holds for the Inv3base part only. 23 of the 38 statements also mention WF3, which gained RootChain (B1) and RootHeld (A4), so their content is not identical. The preceding bullet says statements that conclude WF3 conclude more. That is wrong for addAuth_needs_live_holder: it concludes `¬ WF3 (s.addAuth …)`, which is weaker under a stronger WF3. The witness still works, because every other hypothesis of addAuth_preserves holds and the proof refutes the possession clause (`h'.poss`). This is a documentation inaccuracy. No statement is weakened.
findings.evidence: Recomputed statement diff (scratchpad/stmts.py, pass-2 p2.lean vs Ern/MM03.lean): 269 / 369, removed 2, changed 52, same 215, identical to p3/p2p3_diff.txt. Normalising Inv3base→Inv3 gives RENAME 38, EXITK 10, OTHER 4 (scratchpad/rev7/statements/norm.py). Among the 38 RENAME, 23 contain `WF3`: addAuth_preserves, derive_preserves, split_aux, split_preserves_underDD, release_preserves, transfer_preserves, depend_preserves, write3_preserves, enter_preserves, releases_preserve, writeShared_preserves, pinEff_preserves, endUse_preserves, endUse_preserves_dependents, free_preserves, free_no_dangling, init_wf, reachable_access_invariant_underDD, arena_issue_preserves_disjointness, arena_reset_preserves_wf, arena_reuse_safe, arena_inv_preserved, addAuth_needs_live_holder. MM03.lean:6155-6158: `WF3 s ∧ Inv3base s ∧ Allows (effective s 0 0) .observe ∧ ¬ WF3 (s.addAuth ⟨.observe, some 0, [0], .frame 7, true⟩)`.

findings.title: Report (i) and (m) state unconditionally that reached and arena states are in the new WF3 domain; the cited theorems need DDSound k and ArenaInv
findings.location: formal/reports/MM03_v0.1_p3.md (i) "Tout état atteint reste dans le domaine…"; (m) "Les états produits par issue et reset sont couverts aussi…"; the "Corrections" table, RootHeld row
findings.claim: The (i) justification for narrowing the 14 WF3-only statements is: "Tout état atteint reste dans le domaine, puisque reachable_access_invariant_underDD établit le nouveau WF3". That theorem requires `DDSound k`, and `Reachable` has no issue or reset constructor. (m) and the corrections table say states produced by issue are covered "puisque ces opérations préservent WF3". The only WF3 preservation for issue, arena_issue_preserves_disjointness, also requires `ArenaInv s ar`, and no theorem chains arena steps with the other steps. Nothing is lost relative to pass 2, which had the same conditions, and case 16 is coverable (see evidence). The sentences should still state the DDSound and ArenaInv conditions instead of claiming unconditional coverage.
findings.evidence: MM03.lean:4652 `reachable_access_invariant_underDD {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) … : WF3 s ∧ Inv3base s`; MM03.lean:4614-4646 `Reachable` constructors: no issue or reset; MM03.lean:5013-5015 `arena_issue_preserves_disjointness … (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s) (hai : ArenaInv s ar)`. Positive check: scratchpad/rev7/statements/c16.lean proves `ArenaInv c16b ar16`, composes reachability, issue and transfer into `WF3 (transferEff c16c.1 5 4)`, and applies exitFrame_no_dangling to the exit of case 16. Output: `'c16_closure' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]`. The case-16 claim is therefore true but derived only outside the module.

findings.title: (d) 4 omits alloc_fail_unchanged, which restates the premises of a constructor like issue_fail_unchanged did in pass 2
findings.claim: Spec §10: "Une preuve qui réénonce directement une précondition comme conclusion ne constitue pas, à elle seule, une validation suffisante du mécanisme". Pass 2 lists such theorems in (d) 5. Its review required adding issue_fail_unchanged there, as the restatement of the premises of the `fail` constructor. alloc_fail_unchanged, requested by the brief, is the exact analogue: its proof is a case split on the `fail` constructor. Yet pass 3 (d) 4 adds only free_no_pin. The statement itself is faithful to B5. Only the disclosure required by §10 and pass-2 practice is incomplete.
findings.evidence: MM03.lean:3869-3873: `theorem alloc_fail_unchanged … (h : AllocStep k pr ow ex s (.fail s')) : s' = s ∧ AllocStatic k s pr ow ∧ ¬ k.Satisfiable pr ex := by cases h with | fail h1 h2 => exact ⟨rfl, h1, h2⟩`; MM03.lean:3859-3860, constructor `fail : AllocStatic k s provider owner → ¬ k.Satisfiable provider extent → AllocStep … (.fail s)`. Pass-2 report line 80: "(d) 5 omettait `issue_fail_unchanged` parmi les énoncés qui réénoncent une précondition. | Ajouté." Pass-3 report (d) 4: "Théorèmes qui réénoncent une précondition (passe 2, (d) 5). S'y ajoute `free_no_pin`…"
